method: Verified eval_qrels.json equals the rule in scripts/make_fixtures.py (tickets with article_id in the target feature(s)). Parsed every ticket into its two symptom sentences (every one matches a symptom of its feature in FEATURES). For each question I decided by hand, from question text vs symptom text, which symptoms of which features answer it (strong), which only relate (weak), and which do not. A listed ticket is proposed for removal only when neither of its two symptoms is strong or weak. Candidates for 'add' came from tickets of features not in the key whose symptom is strong, plus a word-overlap scan of all 36 questions against all non-key symptoms. Articles were judged at feature level: each article text states one symptom and generic steps. Draft, model labels, spot-check by a person needed. Reviewed with a different model than the one that produced the data, same vendor family.
